Title: Question about Ash Heap and control of vamps

Messages.Author: David Hyatt
Messages.Body:
I have a question about what happens to vampires that are
stolen from one player by another and subsequently burned.
Whose ash heap do they go to?

Example:
Carlotta plays Grave Robbing to grab Cardano from
another player's torpor region. The next turn,
Golconda: Inner Peace is played on Cardano. Does
he return to his original owner's ash heap, or does
he go into the ash heap of the player that stole him?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
d-h...@cs.uiuc.edu (David Hyatt) writes:

>I have a question about what happens to vampires that are
>stolen from one player by another and subsequently burned.
>Whose ash heap do they go to?

To the owner's (usually the original controller's) ashheap.

Messages.Author: Shawn F. Carnes
Messages.Body:
> >I have a question about what happens to vampires that are
> >stolen from one player by another and subsequently burned.
> >Whose ash heap do they go to?
>
> To the owner's (usually the original controller's) ashheap.

OFFICIAL--LSJ is correct. The golden rule of ownership (cards return to
the actual owner of the card) is always in effect, and usually so in
ante games unless the ante card says otherwise.
